title: Financial Crime Operations Analyst (LATAM Focus) - LEVEL 1
description:
Financial Crime Operations Analyst (LATAM Focus) – LEVEL 1

Reap is a global financial technology company headquartered in Hong Kong that empowers businesses worldwide to connect and access finance by combining traditional finance with stablecoins. Through our stablecoin‑powered corporate cards, payments, and expense management tools, we streamline financial operations and help companies scale. Reap’s APIs enable institutions to integrate stablecoin‑enabled finance into their own products, from issuing Visa cards to facilitating cross‑border payments. Backed by leading investors such as Index Ventures and HashKey Capital, Reap is building the future of borderless, stablecoin‑enabled finance.

About the Team

We are building a LATAM operations team focused on financial crime prevention, including client onboarding, KYB screening, AML compliance, and broader risk management. The role is a critical link between Reap’s LATAM expansion, our headquarters in Hong Kong, and the global compliance framework. The position is remote with team members working from LATAM.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive end‑to‑end onboarding and AML operations across the client lifecycle.
  • Conduct KYC/KYB due diligence for new and existing clients, assessing complex corporate structures, international UBOs, and high‑risk business models.
  • Lead periodic reviews and ongoing monitoring, re‑rating risk exposure to align with internal AML policies and evolving risk appetite.
  • Interpret data trends to identify policy gaps, process inefficiencies, or client behavioral red flags; collaborate with analytics or product teams to refine rules and controls.
  • Draft and enhance SOPs, control checklists, and workflows in alignment with global AML/CTF policies; partner with QA to ensure consistency and execution quality.
  • Design and implement the maker‑checker (2‑eye/4‑eye) process; serve as checker for escalated or sensitive cases.

Minimum Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in onboarding operations, due diligence, or transaction monitoring; ideally with fintech, payments, EMIs/MSBs, cards, or regulated financial institutions.
  • Proven end‑to‑end KYC/KYB and onboarding operations with a track record of delivering high‑quality service under strict SLA standards.

AML Knowledge

  • Familiarity with global AML/CTF standards (FATF, CNBV, UIF, BCB, and relevant regulations in Mexico and Brazil).
  • Experience implementing or managing 2‑eye/4‑eye review frameworks and performing the checker role on risk‑sensitive cases.
  • Ability to detect and identify unusual activity patterns that lead to new types of unusual behavior.

Project Ownership

  • Strong ownership mindset; able to lead and deliver small‑to‑medium AML projects and tasks.
  • Comfortable coordinating across teams such as Product, Growth, Legal, Compliance, and Finance Ops.

Language Proficiency

  • Fluent in business English (spoken and written).
  • Ability to read and speak Portuguese; a strong advantage for candidates outside Brazil.

Artificial Intelligence Knowledge

  • Experience and knowledge using AI tools is a plus.

Seniority: Mid‑Senior level
Employment type: Full‑time
Job function: Finance and Sales

We are specialists in technology, data, and design, driving the digital transformation of major market players for over 10 years, in the financial, insurance, and mobility sectors. Certified for the 5th consecutive year as a Great Place to Work, here at ília we believe that people change the world, and we invest in them. Our awesome deliveries are made by people for people — after all, awesome people make awesome deliveries! #Cometoília!

The role:

We are looking for experienced professionals, preferably with a background in banking or financial services, and/or experience building Know Your Customer (KYC) or Know Your Business (KYB) processes.

About the project:

We are embarking on a mission to build a cutting‑edge, direct‑to‑consumer digital investment platform for a leader in the financial services industry. The core challenge is to create a seamless and intuitive experience that captures and retains significant assets, particularly from individuals transitioning out of employer‑sponsored retirement plans and those seeking to invest their personal capital.

This is a ground‑up initiative to deliver a modern wealth management solution. You will be at the heart of a strategic, multi‑phased program that fundamentally transforms how our client engages with its customers.

The work:

The project involves architecting and developing a robust platform powered by a modern, API‑based infrastructure. We will integrate with a leading fintech partner to handle the core mechanics of account opening, funding, and trading, allowing our team to focus on building a superior, client‑facing experience.

Success requires more than just great code. You will join a dynamic, cross‑functional team of product managers, UX/UI designers, business strategists, and compliance experts. You will work in close collaboration to navigate complex financial regulations, translate intricate business requirements into elegant technical solutions, and solve challenging integration problems with our external partners. This role is ideal for a proactive problem‑solver who thrives in a collaborative environment and is passionate about building products that have a real‑world impact on people's financial futures.

Requirements:

  • English proficiency: C1 or higher.
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js, with experience using modern frameworks such as NestJS, Express, or Fastify.
  • Experience designing and implementing BFF (Backend for Frontend) layers, ensuring optimized communication between front‑end clients and backend microservices.
  • Advanced knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including communication patterns such as REST and gRPC.
  • Expertise in event‑driven architectures, leveraging tools like RabbitMQ, Kafka, and Amazon SQS.
  • Experience deploying and operating cloud‑based applications (AWS or Azure).
  • Proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Implementation and automation of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or ArgoCD.
  • Advanced Git knowledge with collaborative branching strategies (Gitflow, pull requests, code reviews).
  • Familiarity with observability stacks including Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack.
  • Strong focus on testing (unit, integration, e2e) using Jest, Mocha, Supertest, or similar frameworks.
  • Adoption of TDD/BDD principles and continuous code quality improvement.
  • Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Proven track record with high‑volume, low‑latency, and scalable distributed systems.
  • Ability to refactor, optimize, and evolve codebases and architectures continuously.
  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts and asynchronous processing patterns.

Nice to have:

  • Experience developing financial or investment web applications.

Benefits and Incentives:

Our employment model is CLT (Brazilian labor law), with a 40‑hour flexible workweek, performed remotely. ília’s benefits are designed to provide an AWESOME experience for every ílian. Below is a summary of our benefits. #Cometoília

  • Deep expertise with cloud platforms (i.e. AWS), containerization, and serverless/cloud-native architectures

description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

  • Formação de acordo com a área de interesse;
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na área;
  • Salário + Benefícios;
  • Escala e horário de trabalho a serem definidos;
  • Locais de trabalho: Zona Norte, Oeste e Centro do Rio de Janeiro;
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em modalidades contratuais diferentes, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência na gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade a toda a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos de enfermagem e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Warehouse Coordinator
description:
Overview

Company : Saipem is a global leader in the engineering and construction of major projects for the energy and infrastructure sectors, both offshore and onshore. Saipem is "One Company" organized into business lines: Asset Based Services, Drilling, Energy Carriers, Offshore Wind, Sustainable Infrastructures, Robotics & Industrialized Solutions. The company is committed to supporting its clients on the energy transition towards Net Zero with increasingly digital means, technologies and processes geared for environmental sustainability. Listed on the Milan Stock Exchange, Saipem operates in more than 50 countries and employs about 30,000 people of over 130 nationalities. Project: P79 Brazil. Job Title: Warehouse Coordinator. Location: Brazil - Rio.

Job Description

Mission

  • Support the receipt and inspection of materials on arrival at the site in terms of integrity, conformity and quantities, as per specifications/technical drawings, Purchase Orders and Packing Lists
  • Support the adequate handling, storage and preservation of materials, in accordance with the relevant procedures defined by vendors, clients and projects
  • Support the handover and traceability of materials

Tasks

  • Promote safe works practices and environmental protection, ensuring that safety standards are respected
  • Ensure the fulfilment of the project quality and contractual requirements
  • Inspect materials on arrival at site in terms of integrity, conformity and quantities, as per specifications/technical drawings, Purchase Orders and Packing Lists
  • Segregate non-conforming materials
  • Ensure the use of adequate means for handling materials
  • Coordinate materials storage and preservation activities, in accordance with the relevant procedures defined by vendors, clients and projects
  • Communicate to Quality Department when material is ready for inspection
  • Monitor the available and incoming materials and provide assistance for feasibility analysis, issuing the relevant reports
  • Keep updated the relevant Saipem software systems (e.g., MARIAN, MAGA, FMS as applicable)
  • Verify the Test Certificate Number and heat cast number and keep record of the certificates
  • Support and control the handover of materials to Subcontractors and/or construction execution team, accordingly to site procedures, ensuring the record of the vouchers
  • Support and control the shipment of non-conforming materials or of the materials to be repaired
  • Ensure the prompt issue of MRRs (Materials Requisitions Requests) in order to allow materials procurement
  • Coordinate human and technical resources, indicating any needs or surplus
  • Prepare the list of residual materials upon completion of works
  • Coordinate with the Site Construction Manager or the Fabrication Yard Production Planning and Control unit to reconcile materials with clients and/or subcontractor

If the discipline Supervisor is also involved in the Punch list activities the following additional tasks need to be managed:

  • Set-up the proper tools for the management of the punch lists, producing adequate reports to monitor the status of the punch list points (open, closed, closure forecast dates)
  • Plan all the activities related to punch lists management
  • Perform the walkthroughs
  • Ensure that punch lists issued after walkthroughs are promptly notified and correctly drawn up and recorded
  • Ensure the correct classification of the punch lists and identify the owner for each point
  • Coordinate the assigned team, managing interfaces with construction, engineering and commissioning teams to close the punch lists. Negotiate with the Client the punch lists and their classifications, in accordance with contractual scope of work and project requirements
  • Ensure that the corrective actions identified for punch lists closure are carried out and notified to the Client, to obtain the close-out form signed
  • Archive all the punch list reports for traceability

What are we looking for?

  • Languages: English language skills required; Portuguese is a plus
  • Technical Knowledge: Offshore experience required (FPSO, drilling, offshore construction, ...)
  • What else should you know? Assignment is based onshore

What we can offer to you

  • 12 months contract (subject to extension according to Company needs)
  • Corporate Benefits : We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance
  • Our One Saipem Way soft skills model leverages skills development, career growth, opportunities to innovate through complex challenges by promoting communication and collaboration to achieve common goals

Additional Information

We embrace diversity! At Saipem, we believe that innovation thrives through diversity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we stand against discrimination based on gender identity, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Saipem companies unique.

Safety and Sustainability matter to us! Operating in difficult and at times extreme situations, the focus is always on the health and safety of people and the preservation of the natural ecosystem.

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área defisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Atender pacientes para prevenção, habilitação e reabilitação da saúde, utilizando protocolos e procedimentos específicos de fonoaudiologia; Tratar pacientes e clientes; Efetuar avaliação e diagnóstico fonoaudiológico; Realizar triagem auditiva neonatal (Emissões Otoacústicas); Realizar o teste da linguinha; Executar atendimento de Motricidade Orofacial ao recém-nascido; Realizar rotina de promoção e incentivo do Aleitamento Materno; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Fonoaudiologia
  • Pós-Graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Audiologia, Linguagem, Motricidade Orofacial, Saúde Coletiva, Disfagia, Fonoaudiologia Neurofuncional, Gerontologia ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Fonoaudiólogo.

Local de Trabalho: Jacarepaguá/RJ

Carga Horária: 30H (diurno e noturno) e 40H (diarista)

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos , bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Responsibilities

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis: Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
  • In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)
  • Skills: Communication, Analytical Skills, Risk Management

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Somos a Dafiti, a maior fashiontech da América Latina. Desde 2011, transformamos a forma como as pessoas consomem moda, unindo tecnologia, inovação e paixão pelo que fazemos. Nossa história começou quando Philipp Povel e Malte Huffmann - criadores do e-commerce MyBrands na Alemanha - se uniram a Malte Horeyseck e Thibaud Lecuyer para revolucionar o mercado brasileiro. No ano seguinte, ampliamos nosso impacto com a abertura da Dafiti na Colômbia. Hoje, fazemos parte do Global Fashion Group (GFG) , líder global em moda online em mercados de alto crescimento, o que potencializa ainda mais nossa atuação e nos conecta a tendências e inovações do mundo inteiro.

No Brasil, contamos com mais de 4 milhões de clientes ativos , oferecendo uma plataforma com mais de 3 mil marcas e mais de 400 mil produtos . Para garantir a melhor experiência, temos o maior centro de distribuição de moda online da América Latina e a maior solução AutoStore do mundo, o Leap, localizado em Extrema-MG.

Somos mais de 1.000 Dafiters , movidos pelo propósito de inspirar as pessoas a se divertirem com a moda. Acreditamos no “sim”: sim para marcas exclusivas, sim para entregas em qualquer lugar, sim para inovação e, principalmente, sim para a diversão! Nossa missão é levar a moda do mundo para todo mundo, tornando-a acessível, democrática e transformadora.

Aqui, valorizamos a diversidade, o trabalho em equipe e a criação de um ambiente acolhedor , onde todos se sintam motivados a entregar o melhor para nossos clientes. Nossa cultura é vibrante, colaborativa e apaixonada pelo negócio. E não esquecemos da nossa responsabilidade social e ambiental. Acreditamos que a moda tem o poder de mudar o mundo e, por isso, buscamos sempre práticas sustentáveis e ações que impactem positivamente a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte de um time inovador, apaixonado e que acredita no poder transformador da moda, seu lugar é aqui. Confira nossas oportunidades e venha construir o futuro da moda com a gente!

  • Desenvolver e evoluir sistemas de alta performance e escalabilidade em Golang;

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outras áreas (produto, dados e marketing) para garantir a entrega de soluções alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos do negócio;
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento, aplicando boas práticas de engenharia de software e explorando o ecossistema Golang;
  • Participar ativamente das etapas do processo de desenvolvimento: levantamento de requisitos, planejamento, desenvolvimento, testes e deploy;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e melhores práticas em desenvolvimento backend, especialmente no que tange a Golang, arquitetura de microsserviços e soluções de pagamento.
  • Noções de infraestrutura com terraform.

A Unico é a maior rede de verificação de identidade do mundo e um pilar de confiança na sociedade digital. Esta é uma posição estratégica para uma pessoa com profundo conhecimento técnico, paixão por resolver problemas complexos e um olhar aguçado para o negócio. Você será a peça-chave na criação de soluções inovadoras que impactarão diretamente a nossa empresa e o mercado.

Você não é apenas uma pessoa que desenvolve código experiente, mas alguém com um olhar visionário, que pensa fora da caixa, desafiando o status quo e criando o que ainda não foi feito.   • Versatilidade Tecnológica: Base sólida em engenharia de software que permite a adaptação a diferentes linguagens, frameworks e paradigmas, sem apego a uma única tecnologia.
  • Inovação e Criatividade: Paixão por explorar novas ideias e a coragem para tentar o que nunca foi feito, liderando a criação de soluções inéditas.
  • Liderança Técnica: Capacidade de guiar e mentorar outros engenheiros, elevando o nível técnico da equipe e influenciando positivamente a cultura de engenharia.

Benefícios

  • Benefício flexível: R$1.500,00 por mês distribuíveis nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias.

Adotamos o modelo de trabalho que prioriza o remoto, com a opção de frequentar escritórios caso queira. Temos escritórios nas cidades de São Paulo e Londrina.

Estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando candidaturas de todas as pessoas independentemente de etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outra característica. title: Security Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Security Engineer role at LEDN

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!
Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.
We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.
Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients – in real terms.
Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds.
What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so.
The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy.
Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.
Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!
The Opportunity
We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform.
Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.
You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches.
In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.
This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.
About The Role
Application Security:
Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
Authentication & Identity
Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)
Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
Additional Security Domains
Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.
What You Bring To Ledn
10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
Experience with Secure Code Review.
Understanding of software supply chain.
Deep understanding of Linux internals.
Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
Nice To Haves
Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.
Culture Fit
We're looking for more than just operational excellence – we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The Ideal Candidate Will
Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
Have worked in a remote environment before.
A Taste Of What We Provide
As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
Ownership in the company.
Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
We remove barriers so you love what you do.
We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.
Requests will be addressed confidentially.
Ledn Working Environment
Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.
We are a remote first environment.

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full‑time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin‑backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing‑resistant approaches.

In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands‑on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Application Security

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and software supply chain security.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals and remediation of vulnerabilities identified in penetration test reports.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and be comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

description:
Join to apply for the Application Security Engineering role at LEDN

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future.

Our product suite includes egalitarian lending, savings and trading products available in over 150 countries. It is built on a modern, secure, and privacy‑respecting technology stack that empowers digital asset holders worldwide.

Ledn is guided by core values: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We believe digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and are committed to playing a critical role in that mission.

Role Overview

We are seeking a full‑time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin‑backed loan platform. This hands‑on engineering role will drive tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads using AWS Nitro Enclaves.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
  • Nice to Haves: Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

We offer a competitive PTO package, shared equity, and a comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day. You may work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days.

About the Company

SuperSummary is transforming how millions of readers discover, understand, and connect with books. We're building the world's most comprehensive literature platform - combining nearly 10,000 expert-written Study Guides with interactive, innovative tools that make reading more engaging, rewarding, and fun.

Beyond summaries, our paid subscription offers chapter-by-chapter analysis, character breakdowns, themes and symbols exploration, thought-provoking discussion questions, and interactive quizzes. Our growing suite of AI-powered features helps readers engage more deeply with texts, whether they're students tackling assignments, teachers preparing lessons, book clubs seeking richer conversations, or lifelong learners exploring new genres.

Founded over a decade ago, SuperSummary’s website and mobile app has become a trusted, go-to resource for curious readers worldwide. We’re part of the Lift Ventures portfolio of EdTech brands (with over 250 million consumers reached to date) and are a fully remote, global team united by curiosity, creativity, and a shared love of learning.

About the Job

SuperSummary is looking for a seasoned, data-driven Performance Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid acquisition channels. You'll be responsible for driving efficient subscriber growth across our core established channels— including Google Ads, Meta, and Apple Search Ads— while pioneering expansion into other promising new channels like TikTok Ads and Creator/Affiliate Partnerships. This role is an opportunity to directly shape how millions of readers discover SuperSummary, combining analytical rigor with hands‑on creative experimentation to drive sustainable growth and ROAS improvements across channels.

You'll work cross‑functionally with our Product, Content, and Analytics teams to develop sophisticated, highly-targeted campaigns that reach students, educators, book club members, and lifelong learners wherever they are. The ideal candidate thrives on experimentation, stays ahead of platform changes, and can balance immediate performance goals with long-term brand building.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage and optimize daily paid media budgets and campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, Apple Search Ads, and other channels to hit CAC and ROAS targets
  • Lead expansion into new ad channels (TikTok, YouTube, Reddit, etc.) and test new strategies (video ads, influencer and affiliate marketing, etc.) to diversify our acquisition mix
  • Develop AI-powered creative testing frameworks in collaboration with designers and copywriters to continuously improve ad performance
  • Build and refine audience segments, bidding strategies, and attribution models to improve efficiency across the funnel
  • Own the performance marketing budget , allocating resources across channels based on incrementality and strategic priorities
  • Run in-depth analyses on website/app engagement, conversion funnel performance, and A/B test performance for paid ads traffic to better understand opportunities for improvement
  • Report on performance to leadership with clear insights and recommendations for optimization
  • Stay current on platform updates , industry trends, and competitive landscape to identify new opportunities

Sample Projects

  • Google Ads deep dive: run AI-powered analyses on our existing strategy to identify and test new keyword/targeting strategies, copy and creative improvements, and bid optimizations
  • TikTok pilot program : Collaborate with our Content team to build SuperSummary's presence on TikTok from scratch, testing BookTok creator partnerships, spark ads, and in‑feed video to establish benchmarks and scale strategy
  • Landing page optimization : Work with Product and Design to build and test dedicated landing pages for key campaigns, improving conversion rates across channels
  • App Store Optimization: Test improvements to our mobile app marketing strategy (new keywords, descriptions, images, etc.) to improve the performance of our app-focused campaigns

Who You Are

  • 4-7+ years of performance marketing/paid media experience at high‑growth companies with particular expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads
  • Proven track record of scaling high‑volume paid channels (via both web and mobile app‑based products) while maintaining or improving efficiency metrics
  • Strong design and copywriting sense and ability to develop effective creative strategies alongside Content and Product team members
  • In‑depth analytical skills with experience using top analytics and A/B testing platforms (Google Analytics, Amplitude, etc.)
  • Prior experience using AI for creative experimentation, campaign analysis, and marketing automation
  • Experience with creator/influencer‑driven marketing strategies on channels like Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.
  • Excellent communicator who thrives in a fully remote, highly collaborative team.
  • B2C, SaaS/subscription, EdTech, or related experience is highly preferred.
  • Work with a distributed, global team in Latin America, Europe, and the US that has been remote‑first since 2018
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and vacation policy

  • Professional development and learning stipend

Também é legal você saber que…

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts! A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África. Quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão "Sawabona". Esse, por sua vez, responde "#Shikoba". Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: "Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim". E a resposta, Shikoba: "Então eu sou bom e existo para você". Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro. title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate, diverse group with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Our core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. We are building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads; integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Harden AWS services with least-privilege IAM and secure key management; improve Kubernetes security posture; deploy and operate a SIEM framework; support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.

Qualifications

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Ability to remediate vulnerabilities identified in pen tests and strong communication skills.

Nice To Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities at Ledn.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package starting on day one.
  • Competitive PTO and remote-friendly policy (up to 180 days remote work).
  • Ownership in the company via shared equity.
  • Opportunity to work remotely worldwide for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • Purpose-driven work; removal of barriers to doing great work.
  • Inclusive, diverse, equal opportunity employer; accommodation requests available during recruitment.
  • Ledn Working Environment: remote-first with global team.
  • Note: due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes.

description:
About LILT

AI is changing how the world communicates — and LILT is leading that transformation.

We're on a mission to make the world's information accessible to everyone , regardless of the language they speak. We use cutting-edge AI, machine translation, and human-in-the-loop expertise to translate content faster, more accurately, and more cost-effectively without compromising on brand, voice, or quality.

At LILT, we empower our teammates with leading tools, global collaboration, and growth opportunities to do their best work. Our company virtues—Work together, win together; Find a way or make one; Quicker than they expect; Quality is Job 1 —guide everything we do. We are trusted by Intel Corporation, Canva, the United States Department of Defense, the United States Air Force, ASICS, and hundreds of global Enterprises. Backed by Sequoia, Intel Capital, and Redpoint, we’re building a category-defining company in a $50B+ global translation market being redefined by AI.

Role Overview

LILT is seeking freelance AI Red Team experts to collaborate on projects focused on adversarial testing of AI systems — LLMs, multimodal models, inference services, RAG/embeddings, and product integrations. Your work will involve crafting prompts and scenarios to test model guardrails, exploring creative ways to bypass restrictions, and systematically documenting outcomes. You’ll think like an adversary to uncover weaknesses, while collaborating with engineers and safety researchers to share findings and improve system defenses.

Key Criteria

  1. Deep Understanding of Generative AI and main models, including their underlying architectures, training processes, and potential failure modes. This includes knowledge of concepts like prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF).
  2. Cybersecurity & Threat Modeling: Experience in cybersecurity principles, including threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing. Ability to identify attack vectors, simulate real-world threats, and understand the potential impact of an attack.
  3. Data Analysis & NLP: Strong analytical skills to dissect model outputs, identify subtle biases or factual errors, and recognize patterns in how the model responds to different inputs. A background in Natural Language Processing (NLP) would be highly beneficial.
  4. Ethical Hacking Mindset: A commitment to using her/his skills for defensive and security-focused purposes, adhering to a strict ethical code, and understanding the importance of responsible disclosure.

Core Requirements

  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics or other related fields.
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above
  • Adversarial thinking
  • Knowledge of vulnerabilities, common model vulnerabilities (prompt injection, prompt-history leakage, data exfiltration via RAG).
  • Experience in AI/ML security, evaluation, and red teaming, particularly with LLMs, AI agents, and RAG pipelines.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Proficient in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
  • Familiar with AI red-teaming frameworks such as garak or PyRIT.

Preferred Requirements

  • Physical-world adversarial testing
  • Experienced with containerization and CI/CD security tools, especially Docker.
  • Proficient in offensive exploitation and exploit development.
  • Skilled in reverse engineering using tools like Ghidra or equivalents.
  • Expertise in network and application security, including web application security.
  • Knowledge of operating system security concepts such as Linux privilege escalation and Windows internals.
  • Familiar with secure coding practices for full-stack development.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $55/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

Our Story

Our founders, Spence and John met at Google working on Google Translate. As researchers at Stanford and Berkeley, they both worked on language technology to make information accessible to everyone. While together at Google, they were amazed to learn that Google Translate wasn’t used for enterprise products and services inside the company.The quality just wasn’t there. So they set out to build something better. LILT was born.

LILT has been a machine learning company since its founding in 2015. At the time, machine translation didn’t meet the quality standard for enterprise translations, so LILT assembled a cutting-edge research team tasked with closing that gap. While meeting customer demand for translation services, LILT has prioritized investments in Large Language Models, human-in-the-loop systems, and now agentic AI.

With AI innovation accelerating and enterprise demand growing, the next phase of LILT’s journey is just beginning.

Our Tech

What sets our platform apart:

  • Brand-aware AI that learns your voice, tone, and terminology to ensure every translation is accurate and consistent
  • Agentic AI workflows that automate the entire translation process from content ingestion to quality review to publishing
  • 100+ native integrations with systems like Adobe Experience Manager, Webflow, Salesforce, GitHub, and Google Drive to simplify content translation
  • Human-in-the-loop reviews via our global network of professional linguists, for high-impact content that requires expert review

LILT in the News

  • Featured in The Software Report’s Top 100 Software Companies!
  • LILT makes it onto the Inc. 5000 List.
  • LILT’s continues to be an intellectual powerhouse, holding numerous patents that help power the most efficient and sophisticated AI and language models in the industry.
  • Check out all our news on our website.

Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

  • Prepares written responses to clients in accordance with established procedures.

  • Implements and maintains the Company’s Quality System within assigned areas of responsibility.
  • Prepares accurate billing for clients.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Be familiar with Finite Element Analysis software packages (FEMAP/Nastran preferably) and expertise in structural analysis in offshore/marine industry.

  • Knowledge of applicable Rules and Regulations and the impact of Rule applications and interpretations.
  • Knowledge of company business policies and procedures.
  • The human relations skills necessary to maintain positive client contacts and provide mentorship and motivation to subordinate staff and peers.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing.

The incumbent generally reports to a Department Head or Manager but may report to others depending on the specifics of the assignment. There are no direct reports for this position.

  • Desenvolver a coordenação (Talent Ops: dados/ATS/treinamento) com objetivos claros e coaching.

Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência sólida em TA com volume e mudança de estágio (já organizou processo e fez o ATS trabalhar a favor);
  • Capacidade de planejar e priorizar, negociar com gestores com base em dados;
  • Execução forte em sourcing e triagem; escrita objetiva para contatos;
  • Conforto em ler funil e decidir (pipeline, tempos, motivos);
  • Excel avançado;
  • Comunicação direta e habilidade de formar/treinar equipe (player-coach);
  • Inglês avançado/funcional;
  • Diferencial: vivência em mídia, esportes ou operações com picos/eventos.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Implantação de ATS moderno com scorecards e planos de entrevista.
  • Structured hiring e treinamento de entrevistadores.
  • Recruiting Ops: automações simples e painéis (Sheets/Looker/Metabase).
  • Sourcing avançado (busca booleana, mensagens curtas) e talent pool ativo.
  • Vivência com picos/eventos e mix de áreas (corporativo, comercial, conteúdo/ops).

Nossa cultura
Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.
SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES ontem, hoje e sempre
Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.
SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE não uma família ou a confraria de amigos
Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não tá entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor pra empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.
SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande
A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.
O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.
