title: Repórter - Tribunais Superiores
description:
Sobre o Bastidor Somos um veículo criado em **** por Diego Escosteguy com a missão de iluminar os segredos do poder. Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público. Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.

Sobre a vaga Procuramos um repórter para cobrir, in loco, os tribunais superiores em Brasília, sobretudo Supremo Tribunal Federal e Superior Tribunal de Justiça. Experiência é desejável, mas não é o mais importante; buscamos talentos que tenham disposição para aprender e vontade de se tornar um grande repórter. Nossa cobertura de STF e STJ envolve tanto movimentos de bastidor e articulações por nomeações no Judiciário quanto acompanhamento de processos relevantes - sempre sob a supervisão de nossos editores.

Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar pautas (plenário/turmas), ler petições, votos, ementas e acórdãos.
  • Acompanhar liminares, pedidos de vista e movimentação processual (PJe, jurisprudência).
  • Mapear litigância estratégica de empresas, políticos e setores.
  • Construir e manter fontes (gabinetes, advocacia, PGR/AGU, academia, sociedade civil) com ética.
  • Produzir reportagens explicativas e investigativas com documentação sólida.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com editores e colegas para desenvolver pautas próprias e séries investigativas.
  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (clareza, lógica, gramática e edição).
  • Técnicas básicas de apuração; leitura cuidadosa de documentos jurídicos.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de STF e STJ (pautas, ritos, institutos).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.
  • Conforto com planilhas e pesquisa em bases públicas; disposição para aprender IA.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Formação/experiência em Direito ou cobertura de tribunais superiores.
  • Noções de pesquisa jurisprudencial e leitura de dados de litigância.
  • Inglês de leitura.

O que você aprenderá no Bastidor

  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).
  • Análise empírica e lógica de evidências e valoração criteriosa de fatos (epistemologia aplicada ao jornalismo).
  • Redação assertiva, equilibrada e clara, sem clichês, ilações ou hipérboles.
  • Uso avançado de IA e ML para organização, pesquisa e análise de casos.
  • Segurança operacional (física e digital) e proteção de fontes e documentos.

Como se candidatar Envie seu currículo para ****** com "Repórter Tribunais Superiores" e seu nome no campo de assunto. Inclua links para até três reportagens de sua autoria e um texto de até 300 palavras que descreva por que você quer trabalhar conosco.

Agro e Transformação Digital – características do agro brasileiro, desafios tecnológicos e iniciativas de inovação. Dados no Campo – fontes (sensores, drones, satélites, sistemas de gestão), tipos de dados, pré-processamento, armazenamento, pipelines de dados e qualidade. Aplicações da IA – pecuária de precisão (monitoramento, saúde, alimentação, produtividade) e integração de tecnologias (drones, IoT, decisões em tempo real). IA Generativa – usos no agro (relatórios, previsões, simulações, assistentes virtuais), modelos disponíveis, ferramentas e limitações. Mercado e Cases – startups, plataformas e resultados alcançados. Ética e Sustentabilidade – uso responsável de dados e automação, impactos ambientais, inclusão digital e desafios regulatórios, clareza na comunicação escrita e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Análise e Otimização Visual (Imagens): Conferir as imagens presentes no material, verificando sua correção, adequação ao tema, público-alvo e contexto. Propor substituições de imagens, se necessário, indicando opções de bancos de imagens ou imagens autorais com boa resolução. Garantir que as imagens selecionadas ou propostas estejam em alta qualidade e resolvam visualmente as necessidades do texto. Garantia de Qualidade e Alinhamento: Validar as atividades e seus feedbacks para assegurar que simulam casos reais e incentivam a tomada de decisão. Validar materiais complementares, confirmando sua adequação ao público-alvo e sugerindo novos, se pertinente. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. Responsabilizar-se por sinalizar e implementar os ajustes necessários para garantir a integridade e precisão do conteúdo. Conferir e recomendar bibliografia ou material complementar. Capacitação: Realizaremos um momento de alinhamento e capacitação com o validador, para garantir que ele compreenda integralmente as diretrizes pedagógicas, os objetivos do curso e os parâmetros esperados para a atualização. Validação interna da equipe (DI): Após a entrega do conteúdo validado, a DI realizará uma leitura e solicitará os ajustes necessários, assegurando a coerência pedagógica, a aderência aos objetivos de aprendizagem e a qualidade do material produzido. Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

PARA PRESTAR ESTE SERVIÇO VOCÊ PRECISA DE:

Expertise nos temas mencionados acima. Desejável experiência em validação de material didático para EaD;

description:
Overview

This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of Adzuna. We are currently looking for a Head of Sales - North America in the United States.

This role provides the opportunity to lead and scale the North American sales organization, driving revenue growth across multiple client segments and products. You will manage a high-performing team, collaborate with cross-functional departments including Partnerships, Product, and Marketing, and develop strategies to expand market share and enterprise relationships. The ideal candidate is a seasoned sales leader with experience building teams, winning major enterprise clients, and bringing innovative solutions to market.   • Analyze performance metrics and optimize sales strategies based on data-driven insights.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in sales leadership, account management, or business development, preferably in SaaS, digital advertising, or related fields.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing sales teams and bringing new products to market.
  • Demonstrated ability to win new business from major enterprises, including competing against established industry incumbents.
  • Strong leadership skills, capable of leading by example while motivating and coaching a team.
  • Excellent numerical, analytical, and strategic planning skills to manage client campaigns and sales performance.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to establish rapport internally and externally.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, resilience, and a strong work ethic.
  • Experience in selling to Talent Management, HR, or Recruiters is a plus.
  • Experience working for challenger brands or with global businesses across multiple time zones is a plus.

Knowledge of programmatic ad buying is advantageous

Benefits

  • Competitive financial package, including base salary, commission, bonus, and stock options.
  • Comprehensive health coverage and enhanced parental leave.
  • 25 days of paid holiday plus 8 bank holidays and 3 paid volunteer days per year.
  • Flexible and hybrid working options, including remote work opportunities and flexible office schedules.
  • Professional development through training programs, conferences, coaching, and mentorship.
  • Inclusive and diverse work environment with active DE&I programs.
  • Engaging social calendar with virtual and in-person team events.
  • Opportunity to contribute to a mission-driven company transforming the job search experience.

Jobgether is a Talent Matching Platform that partners with companies worldwide to efficiently connect top talent with the right opportunities through AI-driven job matching. When you apply, your profile goes through our AI-powered screening process designed to identify top talent efficiently and fairly. Our AI evaluates your CV and LinkedIn profile thoroughly, analyzing your skills, experience, and achievements. It compares your profile to the job's core requirements and past success factors to determine your match score. Based on this analysis, we automatically shortlist the 3 candidates with the highest match to the role. When necessary, our human team may perform an additional manual review to ensure no strong profile is missed. The process is transparent, skills-based, and free of bias - focusing solely on your fit for the role. Once the shortlist is completed, we share it directly with the company that owns the job opening. The final decision and next steps (such as interviews or additional assessments) are then made by their internal hiring team.

Thank you for your interest!

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis - Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
  • In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

title: Scrum Master Manager (Projetos de Implementação)
description:
Nosso cliente é uma multinacional norte-americana de grande porte, referência global em soluções de tecnologia para gestão de folha de pagamento, recursos humanos e compliance fiscal. Presente em mais de 140 países, atende organizações de diversos portes e segmentos, oferecendo inovação, excelência em serviços e sólida reputação no mercado.

A posição

Profissional responsável por facilitar o planejamento e a execução de Program Increments (PI), liderando todas as fases dos projetos e promovendo a colaboração entre equipes multifuncionais. Atua como elo entre stakeholders e times ágeis, garantindo o alinhamento estratégico, a eficiência operacional e a entrega de resultados de alto valor.

Responsabilidades

  • Facilitar o Planejamento de Incremento de Programa (PI Planning) , colaborando com outros Scrum Masters e o Business Owner. Isso inclui a preparação para o PI Planning, elaboração de planos de PI, coordenação com outras equipes, criação dos objetivos do time para o PI e revisão dos planos finais.
  • Apoiar a Execução das Iterações , facilitando eventos essenciais do ScrumXP, como refinamento do backlog, planejamento da iteração, reuniões diárias (daily stand-ups) e retrospectivas, garantindo alinhamento e progresso contínuo entre os sprints.
  • Liderar todas as fases dos projetos, desde o business case e a iniciação até o encerramento, assegurando que as entregas atendam aos padrões de qualidade, prazos e orçamento.
  • Direcionar as atividades diárias dos projetos dentro de uma organização matricial, assegurando alocação eficiente de recursos e cumprimento dos cronogramas e orçamentos.
  • Promover uma comunicação clara e eficaz entre todas as equipes envolvidas, motivando e orientando-as para atingir objetivos comuns.
  • Atuar como principal ponto de contato para as partes interessadas (stakeholders), mantendo uma comunicação contínua ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto e garantindo o gerenciamento adequado das expectativas e a clareza nos resultados.
  • Engajar-se com stakeholders seniores (níveis de Diretoria e Vice-Presidência), fornecendo insights estratégicos e atualizações para apoiar a tomada de decisão executiva.
  • Comunicar de forma clara os objetivos, marcos e progressos do projeto em todos os níveis organizacionais, garantindo transparência e alinhamento.
  • Melhorar o fluxo de trabalho estabelecendo e gerenciando o Kanban Board da equipe, medindo e otimizando a eficiência do fluxo e promovendo a qualidade integrada através dos princípios de Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) .
  • Fomentar um ambiente que incentive dinâmicas de equipe de alto desempenho, melhoria contínua e segurança psicológica. Orientar os membros da equipe, resolver conflitos interpessoais e identificar oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Orientar a equipe a focar na entrega de incrementos de alto valor em cada iteração, alinhando os resultados às prioridades organizacionais.
  • Elevar o desempenho do programa facilitando a colaboração entre equipes, construindo confiança com stakeholders internos e assegurando a conclusão bem-sucedida de cada Incremento de Programa.

Requisitos

  • Mentalidade de crescimento demonstrada, com foco contínuo em aprendizado e melhoria.
  • Certificação Scrum Master (preferencial).
  • Certificação PMP ou equivalente em gerenciamento de projetos (diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada com ferramentas e metodologias estruturadas de gerenciamento de projetos.
  • Forte experiência em gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de engajar e influenciar em diversos níveis organizacionais.
  • Sólido conhecimento de frameworks e princípios Ágeis, incluindo SAFe e Scrum.
  • Compreensão dos princípios de Behavior-Driven Development (BDD).

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you’ll join a mission‑driven, fast‑paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting‑edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely payments and building scalable procurement processes at TRM. As a fully remote, global company, TRM requires an AP function that is both efficient and strategic—balancing day‑to‑day execution with process improvements that strengthen vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow, and raise standards for financial discipline.

You will join TRM’s high‑performing Finance team, which leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. Partnering closely with Finance, HR, and cross‑functional teams, you’ll ensure invoices are processed on time, vendors are supported seamlessly, and AP systems evolve to meet the needs of a fast‑growing organization.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payment operations : Consistently achieve >95% on‑time and accurate payments while completing AP close within target timelines to support cash flow visibility.
  • Enhance vendor & employee experience : Manage Zip effectively, onboard vendors quickly, and resolve invoice/payment inquiries while maintaining >90% compliance with card submissions.
  • Streamline procurement : Develop and implement procurement processes, including vendor negotiations, policy rollouts, and measurable cost savings that establish best practices at TRM.
  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.
  • Vendor Invoice Processing & Communication: Upload vendor invoices to the system within 24–48 hours of receipt and respond to vendor email inquiries within 1 business day.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact‑Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high‑impact challenges in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission‑driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone . If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high‑velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you.

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real‑world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote‑first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast‑paced, high‑impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote‑first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem‑solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third‑party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

title: Senior Back-end Engineer - Marketing
description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A leading B2B digital marketing agency that helps associations and businesses reach, engage, and grow their most valued relationships. The company combines B2B media expertise with proprietary audience data to help clients maximize their brand visibility, engagement, and revenue potential across multiple digital channels.

Job Summary

The role involves developing a new system designed to streamline and optimize the management of advertisers, campaigns, and ad groups across multiple advertising platforms and ad servers. The position focuses on building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services that will power the next generation of ad management and reporting tools. The ideal candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to design efficient architectures, ensure data integrity and system performance, and contribute to a robust, future‑ready digital advertising ecosystem.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement backend services and Web APIs following OpenAPI (Swagger) standards, ensuring scalability and maintainability.

  • Develop efficient, modular, and testable code using C# .NET 6+ and Entity Framework (code‑first), applying Dependency Injection and interface‑based programming principles.

  • Design and optimize SQL Server data models and queries, ensuring high performance and data integrity.

  • Deploy and maintain cloud services in Microsoft Azure, leveraging PaaS solutions and integrating secure authentication via Okta or similar Identity Providers.

  • Collaborate within an Agile (Scrum) environment, managing CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and ensuring quality through unit and integration testing.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience developing backend systems with C#/.NET 6 or higher, including building and documenting RESTful APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI.

  • Strong knowledge of software architecture and design principles, including Dependency Injection, IoC containers, and best practices for scalable systems.

  • Proficiency in SQL Server and Entity Framework (Code‑First Migrations), with experience optimizing queries and database performance.

  • Hands‑on experience deploying and maintaining cloud services in Azure, managing CI/CD pipelines and version control through Azure DevOps.

  • Familiarity with Okta or similar identity providers for security integration, and working knowledge of Blazor and automated testing frameworks (unit and integration tests).

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market‑leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

  • Paid Time Off: We value your well‑being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high‑impact projects with Industry‑Leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well‑being and work‑life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

title: Web Developer
description:
If you're into online shopping (who isn't these days?), chances are you've crossed paths with Yotpo. We're all about eCommerce retention—helping brands of every size turn one-time shoppers into lifelong customers.

Think loyalty programs, SMS and email marketing, and reviews—it's what we do best. Plus, we've got more tricks up our sleeve.

With teams spread across the globe—from the US and Canada to the UK, Israel, Bulgaria, and Australia— we're growing fast. Our main mission? Delivering cutting-edge technology that sets new standards in the industry.

Sounds exciting? Then read on, because we’re looking for curious professional talents to be a part of building the future of the e-commerce industry.

Yotpo is seeking a skilled and passionate Web Developer with strong experience in JavaScript, modern frontend frameworks, and clean coding practices to join our Marketing team. This role offers the opportunity to work on large-scale, enterprise-level WordPress projects, building dynamic, high-performing websites while collaborating with global, cross-functional teams such as Product Marketing, Design, Brand, BI, and BA.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop and maintain high-quality, performant, and scalable frontend solutions for our marketing websites and web applications.
  • Work closely with designers to deliver pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible user interfaces.

  • Optimize websites for speed, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Write clean, maintainable code using modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS.
  • Collaborate with backend developers to integrate APIs and other dynamic data sources.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve frontend issues, ensuring seamless user experiences.
  • Stay up-to-date with and implement the latest frontend technologies and best practices.
  • Contribute to server-side rendering and static site generation projects (e.g., Next.js).

What to bring:

  • 3+ years of professional web development experience, with a strong emphasis on frontend development.
  • Strong expertise in JavaScript, React, GSAP, HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS.
  • Solid experience building animated, interactive, and visually rich web pages.
  • Hands-on experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React (preferred) or Vue.
  • Experience building responsive, accessible, and SEO-friendly websites.
  • Strong knowledge of WordPress and PHP (understanding backend structure to better integrate frontend work).
  • Familiarity with MySQL databases is a plus.
  • Knowledge of web performance optimization, efficient rendering techniques, and frontend build tools.
  • Experience with Git for version control.
  • Understanding of server-side rendering and static generation (e.g., Next.js).
  • Great eye for design implementation and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • A proactive, “can-do” attitude and passion for frontend innovation

Why Choose Us?

  • Build Your Career Growth : dynamic organization offering personalized career growth, and recognition.
  • Be a Passionate Crafter: dedicated to the art of crafting, high level of skills and creativity.
  • Be The Best Version of Yourself: combine individual voice and unique quirks to create

If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, that’s okay! We believe in hiring people, not just skills. If you have a passion to learn and are excited about eCommerce and technology, then we want to hear from you.

Help us be the best version of Yotpo by building something great together!

Position Overview

Parsons is seeking a Senior Compensation Manager, Incentive Compensation to take end-to-end ownership of our cash incentive programs, stock incentive plans, and overall equity administration—including the Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP). This role also serves as the primary point of contact for incentive compensation audit requests directed to the Compensation Team.

The ideal candidate is a motivated professional with a strong background in administering cash incentive programs, Proxy CD&A compensation and pay versus performance tables. This position requires a self-directed, ambitious individual who thrives in a dynamic environment and collaborates effectively across cross-functional teams to achieve organizational goals. The role offers a mix of recurring responsibilities and initiative-driven projects.

As part of a high-performing team of human resources professionals, you will lead through influence, collaboration, and expertise. Reporting to the Director of Compensation, this role is fully remote/virtual.

Key Responsibilities

  • Incentive Program Ownership
    • Manage the full lifecycle of cash-based incentive programs (STI and deferral) and stock-based incentive programs (LTI and ESPP).
    • Actively lead and mentor a team of two compensation professionals.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally to drive alignment, consistency, and excellence in program delivery.
    • Provide technical expertise to identify, assess, and execute ongoing program and process improvements.
  • Communication & Reporting
    • Develop and implement comprehensive communication plans to ensure leaders are aligned and equipped to engage program participants effectively.
    • Create accurate tracking, reporting, and forecasting solutions for all incentive programs.
    • Conduct regular audits and validations with key stakeholders to ensure program accuracy and compliance.
  • Collaboration & Issue Resolution
    • Partner with finance and payroll teams to ensure accurate and timely forecasting, reporting, and payments.
    • Address and resolve escalated participant questions or issues related to incentive plans promptly and accurately.
  • Technical Oversight
    • Partner with HRIT to translate business and operational needs into system requirements (Workday), oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), and ensure leadership alignment on decisions and recommendations.
  • Additional Contributions
    • Serve as a key contributor to Parsons’ Proxy Compensation & Discussion Analysis compensation and pay versus performance tables, and various Committee / Board materials.
    • Respond to and manage audit requests from internal and external stakeholders, ensuring proper delegation within the Compensation Team.
    • Lead or provide consultation on incentive compensation-related project initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience
    • 10+ years of related experience in incentive compensation, including some experience managing a team.
    • Industry experience in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure is preferred.
  • Technical & Analytical Skills
    • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to understand broader concepts and communicate persuasively with HR and business leaders.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Preferred experience with Workday.
  • Interpersonal & Leadership Skills
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.
    • Proven ability to build and leverage relationships across an organization.
    • Strong professionalism, personal accountability, and resilience, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a demanding environment.
    • Demonstrated integrity, objectivity, and the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
  • Certifications
    • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation preferred, or progress toward CCP certification.

None

$108,700.00 - $190,200.00

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Join to apply for the Hedge Accounting Specialist role at TechnipFMC

Job Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description

  • Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
  • OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
  • Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
  • Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
  • Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
  • Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
  • Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
  • FX Analysis: Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data‑driven insights.

You Are Meant For This Job If

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
  • Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
  • Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk managementIn-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
  • Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

Skills

  • Communication
  • Analytical Skills
  • Risk Management

We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain.

  • Analisar métricas de desempenho e indicadores de marketing (tráfego, conversão, custo por lead, engajamento, ROI), transformando dados em insights práticos para tomada de decisão.

  • Supervisionar o cumprimento do calendário editorial e dos fluxos de automação, garantindo consistência na comunicação e relacionamento com leads e clientes.
  • Acompanhar os resultados de inbound marketing e funil de conversão, propondo melhorias contínuas para atrair, nutrir e converter leads.

  • Participar ativamente das reuniões de resultado e planejamento com a diretoria, apresentando dados consolidados e novas oportunidades de crescimento.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação tático-operacionais, traduzindo a estratégia de marketing em tarefas concretas para o time e fornecedores.
  • Monitorar a execução do orçamento operacional de marketing, assegurando eficiência e uso estratégico dos recursos.

Principais Objetivos Do Cargo

  • Aumentar o tráfego orgânico do site e blogs da empresa.
  • Gerar leads qualificados B2B e B2C, aumentando as oportunidades de negócio.
  • Elevar o reconhecimento da marca em canais digitais e offline, consolidando a autoridade da empresa no segmento.
  • Aumentar o número de leads pagos e monitorar continuamente o ROI das ações de marketing e comercial.
  • Melhorar a comunicação interna e integração de colaboradores por meio de ações de endomarketing eficazes.

Indicadores de Sucesso (KPIs)

  • Crescimento do tráfego orgânico (visitas e palavras-chave ranqueadas).
  • Taxa de conversão de leads (orgânicos e pagos).
  • Engajamento e alcance das campanhas digitais.
  • ROI das ações de marketing.
  • Cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das entregas.
  • Satisfação e desenvolvimento da equipe de marketing.

Requisitos

Formação em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;

Sólida Experiência comprovada em coordenação de equipes de marketing;

Conhecimento sólido em mídia paga, SEO, marketing de conteúdo e gestão de CRM;

Capacidade de analisar métricas e dados de performance (Google Analytics, RD Station, HubSpot ou similares);

Vivência em planejamento e execução de eventos corporativos e campanhas omnichannel;

Noções de branding, funil de vendas e jornada do cliente;

Habilidade em liderança, comunicação e colaboração interdepartamental (especialmente com áreas comercial e RH).

ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a leading consumer finance company dedicated to helping people achieve their goals through responsible lending. Through its fully-digital platform, Happy Money partners with credit unions, banks and asset managers to originate high-quality credit solutions, diversify their portfolios and expand their impact and reach nationwide.

Backed by investors like TruStage Ventures, Happy Money enables financial institutions to grow as a force for good in their communities while helping people use money as a tool for their happiness. Together with their community-focused capital partner network, Happy Money has originated over $6 billion in loans representing more than 300,000 members who have taken greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Lead Analyst in the Pricing & Conversion team at Happy Money, you will be responsible for developing, analyzing, and optimizing our application conversion and pricing strategy. Sitting within the Risk and Analytics team, you will own analytics and strategy changes, periodic reporting, and initiatives that enhance our funnel conversion and optimize leads.

You will work cross-functionally with Credit Operations, Product, and Engineering to drive proactive, data-driven strategies that support responsible growth for Happy Money and our lending partners.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Conversion:

  • Optimize our conversion rate by continuously streamlining our origination process and improving user experience.
  • Lead efforts to improve automation opportunities while balancing risk and customer experience.
  • Manage and optimize existing strategies effectively by designing A/B tests to understand the right risk-return balance.
  • Identify and evaluate new vendors / data sources and create business cases and present them to senior management.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis related to risk management, product, and operations.

Pricing:

  • Develop and implement credit strategies leveraging data, machine learning models and advanced analytics tools to mitigate losses and maintain excellent customer experience.
  • Continue to innovate by testing new data, analytical approaches and models.
  • Monitor and analyze portfolio performance at a granular segment level on an ongoing basis. Identify trends and conduct root-cause analysis to isolate key performance drivers.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to the Risk Management and broader Happy Money community in a clear and concise manner.

ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years of experience managing credit risk strategies.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or Economics.
  • Strong proficiency with Python & SQL and the ability to analyze large, complex datasets and derive actionable insights.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills coupled with deep experience working in Originations strategies and/or processes.
  • Experience with credit orchestration and decisioning tools (e.g., Oscilar, LoanPro, Strata, Zoot, ACAPS) preferred.

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Eligible for Annual Bonus
  • 401k Plan with a matching contribution
  • Flexible PTO
  • Monthly Health and Wellness Days
  • 12 Weeks Paid Parental Leave
  • Company-paid short & long term disability and life insurance
  • Monthly tech stipend to help cover expenses for remote work
  • Happy Money is a 100% fully distributed workforce

$165,000-$180,000 USD

title: Especialista em Projetos e Processos / Hibrído - Rio de Janeiro
description:
Especialista em Projetos e Processos / Híbrido - Rio de Janeiro

Join to apply for the Especialista em Projetos e Processos / Híbrido - Rio de Janeiro role at Capco.

Sobre a CAPCO

A CAPCO é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia. Somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes e temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico. Se você mora no Rio de Janeiro - RJ ou região, dê uma olhada!

Objetivo

Atuar estrategicamente em subeixos como conformidade, desenvolvimento de competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital, por meio da coordenação técnica, análise crítica, identificação de riscos e oportunidades, e desenvolvimento de soluções e melhorias nos processos organizacionais, oferecendo consultorias especializadas que contribuam para a eficiência, inovação e evolução contínua das atividades.

Atividades

Atuar nos subeixos de conformidade, desenvolvimento de habilidades e competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital, realizando coordenação técnica, análises críticas, apoio estratégico, otimizações, estudos técnicos, condução de trabalhos técnicos especializados, desenvolvimento de soluções, melhoria dos processos e atividades, consultorias, identificação de riscos e oportunidades.

Escolaridade

Pós-graduação: Com carga horária mínima de 360 horas de acordo com os subeixos de atuação.

Graduação: De acordo com o descrito em cada perfil abaixo.

Perfil 1: Comunicação e Marketing Digital

Escolaridade:

Comunicação ou áreas correlatas, tais como Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Administração, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com pós-graduação ou cursos de especialização em Marketing Digital, Comunicação Integrada ou Gestão de Mídias Digitais.

Experiência:

Liderança de equipes multidisciplinares nas áreas de comunicação e marketing digital, atuando de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento, execução e gestão de projetos de comunicação corporativa, branding, campanhas digitais e posicionamento de marcas.

Conhecimentos:

Domínio de ferramentas e estratégias de comunicação digital, incluindo gestão de redes sociais, planejamento de conteúdo, campanhas de mídia paga, SEO, analytics, inbound marketing, automação de marketing e relacionamento com influenciadores. Capacidade de análise de métricas e resultados, visando otimização de ações e aumento do engajamento e conversão.

Requisitos desejáveis:

Habilidade para liderar equipes, gerir projetos simultâneos, promover inovação, estimular o desenvolvimento contínuo dos colaboradores e garantir alinhamento das ações de comunicação aos objetivos organizacionais. Experiência em gerenciamento de crises de imagem, elaboração de relatórios executivos, interface com áreas internas e externas e atuação orientada por resultados.

Perfil 2: User Experience Designer

Escolaridade:

Design, Comunicação, Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia, Psicologia, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização ou cursos de extensão em UX/UI Design, Design de Interação, Experiência do Usuário ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência:

Em projetos de UX/UI Design, com apresentação de portfólio que evidencie resultados concretos, cases de sucesso e participação em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais focados na experiência do usuário. Domínio do processo completo de UX Design, incluindo pesquisa com usuários (UX research), definição e desenvolvimento de personas, mapeamento de jornadas do usuário, elaboração de wireframes, prototipação em diferentes níveis de fidelidade (baixa, média e alta) e realização de testes de usabilidade. Habilidade para criar interfaces visuais atraentes, funcionais e acessíveis, com domínio em design de layouts, escolha de esquemas de cores, tipografia e aplicação de elementos interativos, sempre alinhados às necessidades dos usuários e aos objetivos do negócio.

Conhecimentos:

Experiência avançada com ferramentas de design e prototipação, especialmente Figma ou similares (Adobe XD, Sketch, etc.).

Requisitos desejáveis:

Experiência em design e edição de apresentações profissionais de alto impacto para stakeholders e equipes; Habilidades em edição de vídeos para fins de comunicação, treinamento ou divulgação de produtos digitais; Conhecimento em ferramentas da Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate); Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com participação ativa em squads de desenvolvimento.

Perfil 3: Cientista de Dados

Escolaridade:

Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Física, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou campos correlatos.

Experiência:

No desenvolvimento e implementação de modelos de Machine Learning e Inteligência Artificial em ambiente de produção, com apresentação de portfólio que evidencie resultados concretos, casos de sucesso e participação em projetos aplicados à solução de problemas reais.

Conhecimentos:

Domínio de técnicas de Machine Learning, incluindo algoritmos supervisionados e não supervisionados, validação de modelos, análise de desempenho e ajuste de hiperparâmetros; Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem estatística (análise multivariada, séries temporais), testes de hipóteses e inferência estatística; Habilidade avançada em programação, especialmente em Python, utilizando as principais bibliotecas e frameworks para ciência de dados, machine learning e inteligência artificial; Experiência com tecnologias avançadas de IA, incluindo Large Language Models (LLMs) e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP).

Requisitos desejáveis:

Conhecimento e experiência em ferramentas da Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate); Vivência em ambientes que utilizam metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com participação em equipes multidisciplinares; Familiaridade com Git para controle de versão e colaboração em projetos de código; Perfil desejado: profissional analítico, inovador, com visão estratégica, capacidade para trabalhar em equipe, comunicação clara e foco em soluções que agreguem valor ao negócio por meio do uso inteligente de dados e IA.

Certificações (ao menos uma)

  • CPC-A
  • CIA
  • SiAC
  • ISO9001 ou CertIFR ou Certificação PMI-ACP
  • CBPP
  • BPM ou Lean 6-Sigma (Black Belt) ou Certificação PMP ou PMI-ACP
  • Professional Scrum Master (PSM)
  • Team Kanban Practitioner (TKP)
  • Lean 6-Sigma (Black Belt) ou Certificação Oficial SAFe

Requisitos

  • Sólida experiência na área;
  • Regime Híbrido, com disponibilidade para atuar 3x por semana no Rio de Janeiro.

Sobre a CAPCO: Diversidade e Inclusão

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupos de Mulheres, Pessoas com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros. Nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas para todos(as)!

title: [2025] Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro
description:
(2025) Talent Pool - XP Future | Rio de Janeiro

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grande ecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future - Rio de Janeiro, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo!

  • Graduação superior completa ou estar cursando o último ano em período noturno;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente no Rio de Janeiro;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI)

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
  • Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Essas oportunidades se encontram aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação.

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura:

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia.

description:
Senior Meta Ads Performance Marketing Specialist - Advertising

Join to apply for the Senior Meta Ads Performance Marketing Specialist - Advertising role at Truelogic Software .

Be among the first 25 applicants 1 day ago.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top‑tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

This client believes that as customers move online, brand coverage, social media presence, and overall lifestyle affinity win the day. Now brands of any size can expand their reach to a national or international stage.

Job Summary

We're seeking a high-level Meta Ads Specialist to lead the advertising strategy for a new global e‑commerce venture focused on D2C home decor for European football fans. You will design and execute Meta (Facebook + Instagram) ad campaigns using AI‑enhanced targeting, optimized for conversion across highly passionate, remote fanbases.

This is a hands‑on role. You will operate initially as a contributor reporting to the head of the 2‑person area while laying the groundwork to grow and lead a team in the near future. Strong management skills are a must, even if the current team is a team of one.

Responsibilities

  • Set up and manage Meta ad campaigns focused on ROAS.
  • Use Meta's AI tools to hyper‑target niche audiences.
  • Run simulations to test reach and ad performance across multiple regions.
  • Provide reports, insights, and ad spend guidance to strategic leadership.
  • Collaborate with content and product teams to align on ad creatives and assets.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of Meta Ads experience.
  • Deep understanding of Meta's evolving AI‑based targeting tools.
  • Experience in e‑commerce and/or D2C campaigns.
  • Self‑starter capable of building, executing, and optimizing solo.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Bonus: Experience targeting audiences in Europe, LATAM, and Asia.

What We Offer

  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.
  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market‑leading compensation in USD that goes beyond typical market offerings.
  • Paid Time Off: We value your well‑being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.
  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.
  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high‑impact projects with industry‑leading U.S. Companies.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well‑being and work‑life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.
  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.
  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you’re working with the best in your field.

Apply now!

description:
Precisamos de um(a) fornecedor(a) tutor(a) com experiência em educação e nos atendimentos de alunos, que tenha facilidade no uso de tecnologia, clareza na comunicação escrita e verbal e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

  • Acompanhar diariamente e individualmente alunos no Ambiente Virtual de Aprendizagem, apoiando no entendimento de conceitos e na resolução de problemas;

  • Planejar e executar estratégias no Ambiente Virtual de Aprendizagem que estimulem o pensamento crítico e a participação ativa dos alunos;

  • Mediar processo de aprendizagem e esclarecer dúvidas de forma precisa e com informações relevantes;

  • Mediar fóruns de dúvidas e de discussão;

  • Planejar, cadastrar e conduzir aulas online síncronas por meio de ferramenta de webconferência, agendada no período noturno conforme o calendário de cada Unidade Curricular;

  • Corrigir atividades avaliativas para avaliar o entendimento e o progresso dos alunos ao longo da Unidade Curricular;

Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)

Join to apply for the Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil) role at FIFA Women's World Cup™

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to Senior Venue Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Tournament & Venue Operations team in Zurich, the Venue Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stadium is delivered in full compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements and for leading the operational delivery of all FWWC2027 matches and non-matchday activities at the venue.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão
  • Brasília - Estádio Nacional
  • Fortaleza - Arena Castelão
  • Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio
  • Recife - Arena de Pernambuco
  • Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã
  • Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova
  • São Paulo - Arena Itaquera

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

The position requires the effective and efficient management of all venue operations, ensuring seamless coordination with FIFA’s functional areas as well as internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, issue escalation, problem-solving, innovation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

The Venue Operations Manager will act as a coordinator, facilitator, and decision-maker at the stadium. Together with the FIFA27 Senior Venue Manager, the FIFA FWWC Lead Venue Management team, and the FIFA27 Head of Operations, this role holds ultimate responsibility for venue event planning, operational readiness, and on-site implementation, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the operational delivery of each match day and non-match day at the venue.
  • Will liaise with all functional areas including Competitions, Broadcast, Media, Dressing & Signage, Fan Operations, Pitch Management, Partnerships Rights Delivery, Technical Services & Overlay, Stadium Entertainment, Ticketing, Hospitality, Technology, FTI (Football Technology Innovation), Catering as well as other functional areas such as Services (Logistics, Transport, Guest Management) and Safety, Security, Accreditation & Access and Workforce and Volunteer Management, to ensure the smooth, efficient and effective operation at the venue for all constituent groups.
  • Establish constructive communication channels between FIFA, FIFA27, venue and local authorities and stakeholders.
  • Co-ordinate with all stakeholders (i.e. Host City authorities, venue operators, public transport, police & emergency services) at a venue level through regular coordinated meetings and/or workshops, to ensure the smooth running of events at the venue.
  • To integrate all relevant operational plans into effective venue plans.
  • To assess and validate FIFA’s event requirements to the reality of the venue.
  • Integration of all relevant functional area operational plans into the stadium environment.
  • Risk identification and mitigation across the venue.
  • Supervise and support stadium renovation and construction projects, assuring FIFA requirements are met.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Contribution to workshops, seminars and meetings with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Coordination of policies, requirements and planning with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Co-ordination, planning and delivery of official test events.
  • Plan, manage and implement a good quality and cost-efficient on-site support, service and operations for all relevant FIFA departments as well as other stakeholders (i.e. sponsors, service providers, etc.).
  • Organize and lead Stadium Inspection Tours.
  • Full support to functional areas on site visits, activities and post inspection BIM360 follow up.
  • Manage and review the Stadium budget including regular reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 8 years of management experience in multi-purpose arenas, professional sports clubs, or large-scale international sporting events.
  • Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams with strong stakeholder management skills across international and multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Strong knowledge of event planning, operations, and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and integration of operational plans across multiple functional areas (e.g., security, spectator services, media, broadcast, hospitality).
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large-scale events.
  • Strong understanding of health & safety, risk management, and security regulations in stadium operations.
  • Proven track record in managing complex international projects involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player, able to work collaboratively while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with persistence, resilience, and a positive attitude under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads efficiently during peak operational periods.
  • Sound judgment, critical problem-solving ability, and capacity to make key decisions under pressure.

  • High levels of energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience or knowledge of the local culture and market will be considered an advantage.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-changing environment.
  • Adaptable and culturally sensitive, with proven experience working across international and cross-cultural contexts.

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).

Pharmacovigilance Associate - Brazil - Remote

ICON plc is a world‑leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate at ICON, you will be instrumental in ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products by managing and overseeing pharmacovigilance activities. You will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and to maintain the highest standards of patient safety.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Engaging in audits and inspections conducted by regulatory authorities, ensuring readiness and compliance with all relevant pharmacovigilance requirements.
  • Staying informed on evolving regulatory guidelines and industry best practices to continually enhance the pharmacovigilance processes within the organization.

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or drug safety, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to manage the pharmacovigilance process effectively, including adverse event reporting and signal detection.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross‑functional teams.
  • Proficiency in pharmacovigilance databases and data management systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive patient information with discretion.

What ICON can offer you:

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well‑being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

  • Life assurance
  • Flexible country‑specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.
