Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Kraken is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate all Krakenites for their diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions and unique perspectives. We hire strictly based on merit, meaning we seek out the candidates with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills considered the most suitable for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don\'t fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you\'re passionate or knowledgable about crypto!

As an equal opportunity employer, we don’t tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind. Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

3 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Hi. Great that you are here! This job posting is all about the specific role that you could take at tl;dv. Because company culture is extremely important for us, please also have a look at our tl;dv Culture & Careers page. We love to be different. To get an idea of the brand that we are building, check out our Product Hunt launch. Jack Nicholson will share with you how he thinks about meetings. If you then like what you read - shoot over your application! We're looking for highly motivated team players to join our hungry squad.

Now to Brand Design at tl;dv

Remote-first (worldwide applicants welcome)

Compensation set based on agreed hours / work scope of part-time role (flexible)

Engagement

Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact

Reports to

Founder/Marketing/Head of Design

About The Opportunity

We're building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight moodboard concept production iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought‑leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near‑zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in‑house). You know the category patterns - and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you've got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast‑paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low‑ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & Wordpress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points if You...

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro‑motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb‑stop, offer framing, mobile‑first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

Start part‑time freelance; earn your way into a full‑time seat in = 12 months through results.

Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.

Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What do Include

Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work). For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal your role outcome (metrics if possible). Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets). Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

Email: ******. Important: Share your LinkedIn and portfolio. If you're serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters. We move fast. The more your application stands out, the faster we'll respond.

title: Trade Finance Professionals
description:
Role Overview

Euro Exim Bank, an award‑winning global financial institution seeks freelance‑based sales professionals passionate about trade finance.

Key Responsibilities

Attract new international trade clients (exporters and importers) by offering trade finance services such as Letters of Credit, Standby Letters of Credit, and Bank Guarantees. Generate leads remotely and guide clients through the full sales process.

Commission Structure

All members of the global sales team earn a commission ranging from 6.5% to 15% on successful transaction volumes (terms & conditions apply). Earnings increase with performance growth.

Requirements

  • 1+ year experience in financial consulting, corporate advisory, institution banking, business banking, or related sector.
  • Understanding of KYC, AML, and PEPs is advantageous.
  • Mobile phone, PC with webcam capability, and reliable internet.

Benefits

Work from home at your own pace with no fixed targets. Unlimited potential to set goals and earn higher commissions by bringing own clients and contacts. Regular support from the Bank, ongoing high‑quality training, and professional network expansion.

About Euro Exim Bank

Headquartered in St. Lucia, Euro Exim Bank is an award‑winning international trade finance institution providing trade solutions for importers, contractors, and exporters. Member of Caribbean Association of Banks and International Chamber of Commerce.

description:
Atividades

  • Promoção médica dos produtos do laboratório para um grupo de profissionais selecionados, com o objetivo de transmitir conhecimento técnico-cientifico focando nos diferenciais e benefícios do produto, afim de otimizar as prescrições.
  • Realizando as visitas e cobertura do painel de forma remota através do multicanal (telefone, email e whatsapp) seguindo as estratégias estabelecidas por marketing e vendas.
  • Buscar otimizar a visibilidade e atratividade dos produtos mediante o uso dos materiais de merchandising (e‑mail marketing/ vídeos/ casos clínicos/ cupons de desconto) disponibilizados em cada mês/ciclo pelo laboratório e usar técnicas de vendas comerciais que visam esses aumento de vendas dos produtos.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação completa ou cursando (Graduação em Farmácia será um diferencial)
  • Experiência no setor de Cannabis
  • Conhecimentos intermediário em pacote MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Ter boa comunicação (verbal e escrita).
  • Saber trabalhar com metas semanais e cobrança.
  • Boa organização e planejamento das atividades diárias.

Competências desejáveis

  • Desejável experiência em atendimento telefônico.
  • Ter aptidão para abordagens técnicas comerciais.
